title: LotKeys Info
summary: V0.9.4.79 protects active Vehicle Profile and Marketplace Listing editors from surprise app-update reloads and adds local unfinished-form recovery. Posting Buddy V0.1.20 remains current.

blocks.text: LotKeys no longer reloads or version-forwards an active page when a new Service Worker/build appears. Vehicle Profile and Marketplace Listing editors now save local drafts while you work; an editor that was active during a real reload is reopened and restored on the next boot, while deliberately closed drafts can be resumed for up to 7 days. Browser-selected files that were never saved may still need to be reselected after a full reload. Posting Buddy V0.1.20 is bundled as the current extension. Store Processor V0.9.4.76 remains current.
